content.document_title: 2024 ESC Guidelines for the management of atrial fibrillation - Reviewers
content.summary: Declarations of interest reported to the ESC by experts during the yearly call for declaration covering the previous calendar year (calls conducted during development period up to and including 2023).

declarations.statement: Direct personal payment from healthcare industry: speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member, etc. Companies listed with associated areas: Abbott: Arrhythmias, General; Bristol Myers Squibb: Atrial Fibrillation (AF); Biosense Webster: Atrial Fibrillation (AF). Membership/affiliation in political or advocacy groups in cardiology. President Spanish Heart Rhythm Association.

Payment from healthcare industry: speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member, etc., including travel funding. Companies listed with associated areas: Abbott: Arrhythmias, General; Bristol Myers Squibb: Atrial Fibrillation (AF); Biosense Webster: Atrial Fibrillation (AF). Membership/affiliation in political or advocacy groups in cardiology. Past-president Spanish Heart Rhythm Association.

Research funding from healthcare industry under direct/personal responsibility to department/institution. I-Rhythm: in-kind support (free ECG monitors) for a research project, Co-PI. Extensive membership/affiliation listing including British Heart Foundation UK Academy of Medical Sciences (Fellow), Women As One (Board member), Association of Physicians GB & Northern Ireland - Board of Trustees, WHF (ended Sept 2022), UKRI Medical Research Council - Population and Systems Medicine Board member, International Science Advisory Board of the Netherlands Heart Institute (NHI), Chair Translational Research Group, German Centre for Cardiovascular Research (DZHK TRG) Scientific Advisory Board of the Max Delbrück Centre for Molecular Medicine in the Helmholtz Association, Germany Scientific Advisory Committee of Fondation Leducq IHU LIRYC Research Institute, Bordeaux, France, Board member.
